Slice-fleet-gen2 spec updates from the phase-2 implementation: restore cidata is regenerated per placement via a controlled one-time cloud-init replay (superseding the "preserve the instance-id" sketch, which could not deliver the new static network config); `box_generation` ships as a typed additive wire field (the strict 0.3.16 snapshot was pruned early -- the fleet runs 0.4.1+); `server drain` also destroys the box's unleased pool rows; new open questions record the conversion path's canary-pending assumptions and the phase-2 deferrals.
